annotations.title: Request financing from the Janover desk

description: Send a financing request to the Janover desk on behalf of a property owner or buyer, through the same intake as https://apartment.loans/get-financing/. Use it only when the person asked you to and agreed to be contacted. For business-purpose commercial mortgages on investment property owned by an LLC or other entity: 1-4 unit rentals, apartment buildings of any size and other commercial property. No minimum loan amount. Not for consumer loans or owner-occupied homes. It takes contact details, the property and the loan request only: never send a Social Security number, date of birth, credit, bank or income information. Returns an acknowledgement that the desk received the request. It is not an application approval, a rate quote or a commitment to lend.

business_purpose.description: Must be true: the loan is for business or investment purposes, not personal, family or household use

contact_consent.description: Must be true, and only if the person named agreed to this statement: By submitting, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and you consent to receive calls, texts, and emails from Janover Capital about your inquiry at the contact information provided, including via automated technology. Consent is not a condition of any service. Reply STOP to opt out of texts; message and data rates may apply.

details.description: Optional deal facts: units, occupancy, NOI, current debt, timing. No personal financial data

email.description: Email address where the desk can reach the person

entity_owned.description: Must be true: the property is or will be owned by an LLC, corporation, partnership or other entity

first_name.description: First name of the person requesting financing

loan_amount.description: Approximate loan amount in dollars. No minimum; an estimate is fine

not_owner_occupied.description: Must be true: no owner, guarantor or family member lives or will live in the property

property_location.description: City and state of the property (optional)

purchase_stage.description: Required when loan_purpose is purchase: how far along the purchase is

role.description: Borrower/investor, or a broker acting for one (optional)

name: request_quote
